Definition: to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication, to deceive
BiblicalUsage: 1) to steal, steal away, carry away; 1a) (Qal) to steal; 1b) (Niphal) to be stolen; 1c) (Piel) to steal away; 1d)(Pual) to be stolen away, be brought by stealth; 1e) (Hithpael) to go by stealth, steal away
